name: mycrew-tools
description: Layer 1/5 of the mycrew harness — primitives. Small, project-agnostic skills you or the model reach for while working: /slap resets a stuck fix, /likec4 draws C4 architecture-as-code, /reminder pins one rule file as a hard constraint, /retract hunts down information declared wrong and surgically removes it. Also ships the harness's rule files (rules/) to copy into a project's .claude/rules/. The primitives every layer above builds on.
